detail.title: IT Field Services & Support (FSS) Specialist
detail.jobDescription:
In-Office, New York City, NY

We’re looking for IT Field Services & Support (FSS) Specialist for Amer Sports’ office in New York City, NY.

Amer Sports is a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, powered by a community of people who share a passion for authenticity, impact, and excellence. We bring together leading brands, talented teams, and a culture built on collaboration. If you’re looking for an environment where you can make an impact and grow your career, we invite you to explore the opportunity below.

The Field Services & Support (FSS) Specialist is primarily responsible for providing end user support of computer hardware and software, Active Directory account access, IP phones, Laser Printers, Label printers, mobile devices and all other peripheral devices to internal staff.  They are responsible for helping create/maintain Windows OS images and deployment solutions and handling escalations from the Global Service Desk analysts. 

What you will be doing:

  • Provides end users with technical support via remote access, phone and Email.
  • Handle escalations and provide documentation for the Global Service Desk analysts.
  • Install/upgrade and troubleshoot software related issues.
  • Provide high level support on a large scale environment for InTune/Jamf MDM solutions.
  • Create and maintain Windows OS images using Microsoft deployment technology (MDT, WDS and Autopilot).
  • Maintain Mac environment using JAMF MDM solution.
  • Obtain a good understanding of the Amer Sports/Wilson environment’s software and have the ability to provide software training to clients when needed.
  • Learn the different applications/systems and processes used on a daily basis by the support team.
  • Provides tier 2 support on 3CX PBX and telephony related applications.
  • Ability to deploy/monitor software packages deployed via SCCM/InTune/Jamf.
  • Ability to organize and purchase large amounts of hardware orders (laptops, misc equipment).
  • Support MS Teams audio/video equipment for small and large conference room areas.
  • Provide white-glove IT support for executive leadership.
  • Ad-hoc retail support for infrastructure 
  • Weekend and/or after-hour work may be scheduled as necessary
  • You will report to Manager, IT Field Services & Support
  • Some domestic travel is required for this role.

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Information Systems and/or relevant experience. Equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
  • 3-4 years’ experience in a PC\Telecom network environment.
  • Technical knowledge of macOS, Windows 11, 10 and Windows Server operating systems.
  • Familiar with Internet related applications such as E-Mail clients, FTP clients and Web Browsers.
  • Experience configuring local security policies and group policy management.
  • Experience with Teams rooms and Teams rooms hardware (i.e. Logitech / Cisco/ Yealink)
  • Experience configuring mobile devices (i.e. Android/iOS devices).
  • Experience troubleshooting VPN technologies.
  • SCCM/InTune/MDM experience is required.
  • Familiar with telecom protocols, SIP, PSTN, PRIs etc.
  • Openness to working in an international environment and learning from different perspectives
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to assist the Global Service Desk analysts team.
  • Ability to work toward corporate objectives.
  • Able to work independently and efficiently to meet deadlines but also have the ability to work with others and obtain cooperation internally and with outside parties.
  • Quality of work to include timeliness, completeness and accuracy.
  • Knowledge of department functions so that operations run smoothly in manager’s absence.
  • Ability to provide technical explanations to support issues.
  • Regular and predictable attendance is an essential function of the job.
  • Creation and upkeep of support documentation
  • Ability to lift 50lbs

What we consider a plus:

  • MCP, JAMF, Network +, Security +, and/or InTune certifications are a plus.

What’s in it for you:

At Amer Sports, you’ll be part of a global community of people who care about what they do and how they do it. Across our teams and brands, we are driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared purpose of elevating the world through sport.

Benefits & Compensation:

  • Medical, dental and vision
  • 401k with company match
  • Life insurance
  • Pre-tax transit discounts
  • Paid maternity/paternity leave
  • Smart casual dress
  • Employee product benefits: Enjoy access to employee discounts on quality products from our iconic brands.
  • Global collaboration: Work with diverse, international teams and collaborate across brands, functions, and markets, learning from different perspectives along the way.
  • Modern technologies and ways of working: Be part of teams that work with modern technologies and continuously evolve how we build, operate, and improve our digital solutions.

A reasonable estimate of the annual pay range is $80,000 - $105,000 at the time of this posting. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, education, geographic location, and/or training. Please note that the range reflects the base pay only and does not include our competitive bonus program.

What to expect from the recruitment process

  • CV screening: Every CV is reviewed by a human.
  • Phone screening: A conversation with Amer Sports’ HR manager to discuss the role, our organization, and your expectations.
  • Interviews: Usually 2–4 rounds, including interviews with the hiring manager and prospective team.
  • Case studies or assessments: Your role may require practical tests, such as presentations or case studies.
  • Feedback and decision: We aim to provide feedback throughout the process.

Interested?

Please submit your application via the application form. CVs sent by email will not be considered or processed.

If you have any questions or need clarification at any stage of the application process or during your journey with us, please don't hesitate to reach out to talentacquisition@amersports.com (HR). Apply and join us in striving for excellence at each step!

detail.title: Senior Analyst, SAP FI/CO
detail.jobDescription:
Hybrid, Chicagoland

We’re looking for a Senior Analyst SAP specialized in FI and CO modules for Amer Sports’ office in downtown Chicago, Illinois. 

Amer Sports is a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, powered by a community of people who share a passion for authenticity, impact, and excellence. We bring together leading brands, talented teams, and a culture built on collaboration. If you’re looking for an environment where you can make an impact and grow your career, we invite you to explore the opportunity below.

This role is ideally based in the Chicagoland area, though remote-based candidates in the US are encouraged to apply as we are prioritizing candidate fit over physical location. 

What you will be doing:

We are currently seeking a Senior Analyst, SAP FI/CO who, as part of our SAP applications team, will focus on finance, product costing and controlling functionality.  The Analyst will coordinate and develop requirements between all global business operations for Amer Sports while working closely with Wilson business units locally. You will report to our Director, ESS Business Solutions for North America. 

Specific responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Work with business to determine functional requirements for the system within SAP FICO 
  • Configure SAP FICO to meet the requirements 
  • Manage FICO related projects, people, time, budgets when requested 
  • Work with technical resources to develop reports, functions and enhancements 
  • Provide daily support and training requirements to the business 
  • Collaborate with plant controllers and finance department
  • Understand finance and control end-to-end processes and proactively identify/resolve issues  
  • Coordinate changes with Global team on cross-brand and international topics  

What you need to succeed:

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, math, MIS, or equivalent
  • 7+ years of SAP FICO development / support - preferably in the consumer products industry.  
  • Minimum three full life cycle implementations as an SAP FICO functional analyst / lead in SAP ECC 6.0 and S/4 Hana (in recent releases 2020 or above) 
  • Expert level configuration and design skills in SAP ECC 6.0 and S/4 Hana (in recent releases 2020 or above) 
  • ECC 6.0:
    • FI skills: AP, AR, GL, Banking, fixed assets 
    • CO skills: Cost center accounting, profit center accounting, production costing (make-to-order, make-to-stock), profitability analysis, report painter, and report writer 
  • S/4 Hana:
    • FI skills: Understanding of S/4 Hana new architecture - Universal Journal, various ledgers, currencies & document splitting concepts, AP, AR, GL, Banking, fixed assets.
    • CO skills: Overhead management (CCA, IO), margin analysis, material ledger, multiple valuations, production costing (make-to-order, make-to-stock) and knowledge of various new functionalities within S/4 Hana FICO 
  • Manufacturing experience in both discrete and repetitive environment
  • Knowledge and experience to handle day to day support with SAP S/4 Hana
  • Integration knowledge with other SAP modules MM, PP & SD 
  • A collaborative way of working, contributing to shared progress within a team

What we consider a plus:

  • ECC 6.0:
    • FI skills: Vertex & credit card processing 
  • Knowledge in Variant configuration, fashion and retail operations

What’s in it for you:

At Amer Sports, you’ll be part of a global community of people who care about what they do and how they do it. Across our teams and brands, we are driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared purpose of elevating the world through sport.

  • Pre-tax transit discounts
  • Paid maternity/paternity leave
  • Smart casual dress
  • Employee product benefits: Enjoy access to employee discounts on quality products from our iconic brands.

A reasonable estimate of the annual pay range is $125,000 - $170,000 at the time of this posting. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, education, geographic location, and/or training. Please note that the range reflects the base pay only and does not include our competitive bonus program.

detail.title: Manager, OneStream Administrator
detail.jobDescription:
Hybrid, New York City, NY or Chicago, IL

We’re looking for Manager, OneStream Administrator for Amer Sports’ office in New York City (NY) or in Chicago (IL)!

Amer Sports is a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, powered by a community of people who share a passion for authenticity, impact, and excellence. We bring together leading brands, talented teams, and a culture built on collaboration. If you’re looking for an environment where you can make an impact and grow your career, we invite you to explore the opportunity below.

What you will be doing:

We are seeking an experienced OneStream Administrator to lead the administration and ongoing development of our global OneStream platform. This role requires deep hands-on expertise in OneStream administration combined with the functional finance acumen to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. This individual will serve as a subject matter expert and resource for both day-to-day administration and complex development initiatives, while helping upskill adminstrators transitioning from other EPM technologies to OneStream and ensuring compliance with SOX controls and governance standards. This role will report to our Head of Financial Systems.

Platform Administration & Development

  • Administer and maintain a complex global OneStream application, encompassing financial consolidations (multicurrency, intercompany eliminations, Profit in Inventory eliminations, Non-Controlling Interest), financial planning (forms, dashboards, driver-based and detailed planning), and workforce planning.
  • Lead the design, build, and enhancement of new OneStream functionality, serving as a senior technical resource capable of translating finance and business requirements into robust platform solutions.
  • Create and maintain metadata structures, cube views, form profiles, dashboards, business rules, data sources, transformation rules, workflow profiles, and security configurations.
  • Develop and manage integrations using System Integration Connector (SIC) and other data integration frameworks.
  • Write and maintain VB.NET business rules and SQL queries in support of calculations, data loads, allocations, and reporting requirements.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and resolution of application issues, ensuring platform stability and data integrity.

Stakeholder Engagement & Change Management

  • Serve as platform liaison across Finance, Accounting, FP&A, and IT, translating business needs into technical solutions.
  • Proactively communicate platform changes, impacts, and timelines to process owners ahead of go-live.
  • Lead change management for platform releases, including training and adoption support, to minimize disruption to close and planning cycles.
  • Sequence competing priorities across brand and functional stakeholders, escalating trade-offs as needed.

Team Leadership & Mentoring

  • Guide and mentor newer OneStream administrators, providing technical direction, training, and support to build team capability.
  • Participate in day-to-day administration alongside the team while taking ownership of tasks requiring advanced OneStream expertise and judgment.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, and IT stakeholders to gather requirements and prioritize enhancement initiatives.
  • Contribute to requirements gathering, solution design, and build phases for new development projects.

Compliance, Controls & Documentation

  • Ensure the OneStream platform and all related processes adhere to SOX compliance requirements, including maintaining proper segregation of duties, change management controls, and audit documentation.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive technical and process documentation, including design specifications, configuration guides, and control narratives.
  • Partner with internal and external auditors as needed to support SOX testing and evidence requests.

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Data Analytics, or Management Information Systems.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with OneStream implementing or administering OneStream applications in a corporate environment, with demonstrated proficiency across all core administration areas.
  • 5+ total years of experience working in EPM/CPM systems (e.g. OneStream, Hyperion, etc.)
  • Deep expertise in OneStream platform components including metadata management, cube views, form profiles, dashboards, business rules, data sources, transformation rules, SIC integrations, workflow profiles, and security administration.
  • Track record of leading platform or process changes end-to-end, including communication planning and user adoption, not just technical delivery.
  • Proven experience supporting consolidation processes including multicurrency translation, intercompany eliminations, Profit in Inventory eliminations, and Non-Controlling Interest calculations.
  • Experience with financial planning modules within OneStream, including forms, dashboards, and detailed or driver-based planning.
  • Working knowledge of SOX compliance requirements and the ability to design and maintain controls within the OneStream environment.
  • Proficiency in VB.NET for business rule development and SQL for data analysis and integration support.
  • Strong ability to independently assess requirements, propose solutions, and execute development work with minimal direction.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to take ownership and strive for excellence in how work is planned, executed, and improved.

What we consider a plus:

  • Functional background in accounting or finance (e.g., financial reporting, FP&A, or corporate consolidations), enabling effective translation of business needs into technical design.
  • Experience with workforce planning modules and related data structures within OneStream.
  • Track record of creating clear, thorough technical documentation including design specifications, administration guides, and process narratives.
  • Experience mentoring or training other OneStream administrators or finance systems users.
  • Familiarity with OneStream MarketPlace solutions and extensible platform capabilities.
  • OneStream certification or participation in formal OneStream training programs.

What’s in it for you:

At Amer Sports, you’ll be part of a global community of people who care about what they do and how they do it. Across our teams and brands, we are driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared purpose of elevating the world through sport.

Benefits & Compensation:

  • Medical, dental and vision
  • 401k with company match
  • Life insurance
  • Pre-tax transit discounts
  • Paid maternity/paternity leave
  • Smart casual dress
  • Employee product benefits: Enjoy access to employee discounts on quality products from our iconic brands.

A reasonable estimate of the annual pay range is $130,000 - $160,000 at the time of this posting. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, education, geographic location, and/or training. Please note that the range reflects the base pay only and does not include our competitive bonus program.

What to expect from the recruitment process

  • CV screening: Every CV is reviewed by a human.
  • Phone screening: A conversation with Amer Sports’ HR manager to discuss the role, our organization, and your expectations.
  • Interviews: Usually 2–4 rounds, including interviews with the hiring manager and prospective team.
  • Case studies or assessments: Your role may require practical tests, such as presentations or case studies.
  • Feedback and decision: We aim to provide feedback throughout the process.

Interested?

Please submit your application via the application form. CVs sent by email will not be considered or processed.

If you have any questions or need clarification at any stage of the application process or during your journey with us, please don't hesitate to reach out to talentacquisition@amersports.com (HR). Apply and join us in striving for excellence at each step!

detail.title: Director, Global Tax
detail.jobDescription:
Hybrid, New York, NY or Remote, United States* with ability to work EST hours

Amer Sports is a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, powered by a community of people who share a passion for authenticity, impact, and excellence. We bring together leading brands, talented teams, and a culture built on collaboration. If you’re looking for an environment where you can make an impact and grow your career, we invite you to explore the opportunity below.

We’re looking for a Director, Global Tax for Amer Sports’ Tax team!

What you will be doing:

Amer Sports is seeking a Director, Global Tax to serve as a senior leader within the Global Finance organization, supporting global tax planning, transfer pricing, audit defense, tax risk governance, and the technical tax reporting elements that impact tax returns, provisions, disclosures, and documentation across the Company’s global operations. This role serves as the Company’s lead technical tax advisor for significant transactions and intercompany matters, ensuring tax positions are strategically designed, technically supported, operationally executable, audit-ready, and consistently reflected in tax returns, tax provisions, financial statement disclosures, and supporting documentation.

The ideal candidate is a highly agile, self-driven tax professional with deep international tax, transfer pricing, and controversy experience, along with the ability to translate complex tax matters into clear, decision-ready guidance for senior stakeholders

Specific responsibilities include:

Tax Planning & Strategy

  • Support and execute global tax planning initiatives aligned with business objectives, legal entity structure, intercompany flows, and operational changes.
  • Identify and evaluate tax planning opportunities across jurisdictions to optimize effective tax rate, cash tax, and risk profile.
  • Advise on the tax implications of business restructurings, cross-border transactions, principal structures, and intercompany arrangements.

detail.title: Manager, Workforce Planning & Controlling
detail.jobDescription:
Hybrid, New York City, New York 

We’re looking for Manager, Workforce Planning & Controlling  for Amer Sports’ office in New York.

Amer Sports is a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, powered by a community of people who share a passion for authenticity, impact, and excellence. We bring together leading brands, talented teams, and a culture built on collaboration. If you’re looking for an environment where you can make an impact and grow your career, we invite you to explore the opportunity below.

As Manager, Workforce Planning & Controlling, you will drive the end-to-end planning cycle and analytics of our workforce resources and related personnel costs, running it with the discipline of a project and the rigor of a financial controller.

Reporting directly to the Global Practice Lead, Performance, Rewards, Workforce Planning & People Analytics, this role sits at the intersection of HR, Finance, and business leadership. You will join a small, fast-paced team in a growing global organization, partnering with stakeholders across our Brands, Regions, and Group Functions. Your work will have a direct and measurable impact on workforce, financial, and business decisions worldwide.

What you will be doing:

  • Drive the group-wide workforce planning cadence, including long-range planning, annual business planning, and quarterly forecasting. Manage each cycle as a structured project with clearly defined milestones, owners, dependencies, and deliverables, while ensuring HR and Finance planners stay aligned with timelines across all Brands, Regions, and Group Functions.
  • Design and maintain standardized planning templates, reporting packs, and tools used by HR and Finance planners globally, ensuring consistency, usability, and alignment with Finance reporting standards.
  • Ensure the accuracy and completeness of global workforce plans by establishing and monitoring planning policies, forecast timelines, data quality standards, access controls, data handling practices, and audit trails aligned with Amer Sports data governance requirements.
  • Coordinate and align workforce planning communities by translating planning targets and assumptions into clear direction for planners, influencing local finance controllers and stakeholders without direct authority, and proactively identifying risks and misalignments before they impact delivery.
  • Drive continuous improvement of workforce planning processes and the planner experience in OneStream by identifying friction points, implementing enhancements, and maintaining clear playbooks and guidance materials.
  • Own global workforce statistics reporting, delivering accurate and timely workforce and personnel cost reports for leadership, Finance, and business stakeholders. Establish centralized planning assumptions, monitor data quality, and perform variance analysis between plans and actual results.
  • Partner closely with the OneStream system administration team to translate process requirements into system enhancements, ensuring the planning platform evolves alongside business needs and that technical constraints are addressed proactively.
  • Support strategic initiatives and analyses, including driver-based scenario modeling for workforce and related people costs, variance analysis, and additional HR projects as needed.

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  • 3-5 years of progressive experience in FP&A, financial controlling, people cost analytics or a related function, with demonstrated experience driving complex, multi-stakeholder planning cycles.  
  • Experience with workforce planning or headcount as a financial cost driver within an FP&A or controlling context.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to run a recurring planning cycle as a structured project — managing timelines, escalating risks, and holding distributed stakeholders accountable without direct authority. Formal project management training or certification a plus
  • Demonstrated program and stakeholder management skills to drive planning initiatives; ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong financial modelling skills, including driver-based headcount and people cost models, variance analysis, and scenario planning.
  • Strong data skills and reporting instincts — able to turn raw people data into clean, structured, decision-ready outputs; experienced in building reports and dashboards that non-specialist audiences can act on.
  • Comfortable operating in a process that is still maturing — able to build structure where it doesn’t yet exist, iterate quickly, and bring others along through change.
  • Advanced Excel proficiency including financial modelling; experience with financial planning systems (OneStream strongly preferred) and familiarity with reporting or BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
  • Ability to take ownership and strive for excellence in how work is planned, executed, and improved
  • A pragmatic, curious approach to challenges with a focus on meaningful impact
  • Openness to working in an international environment and learning from different perspectives
  • Motivation to contribute to work that supports healthier, more active lives

What’s in it for you:

At Amer Sports, you’ll be part of a global community of people who care about what they do and how they do it. Across our teams and brands, we are driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared purpose of elevating the world through sport.

Benefits & Compensation:

  • Medical, dental and vision
  • 401k with company match
  • Life insurance
  • Pre-tax transit discounts
  • Paid maternity/paternity leave
  • Smart casual dress

A reasonable estimate of the annual pay range is $125,000 - $145,000 at the time of this posting. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, education, geographic location, and/or training. Please note that the range reflects the base pay only and does not include our competitive bonus program.

  • Access to a global network of leading brands: Work within a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, gaining exposure to different businesses, perspectives, and opportunities across Amer Sports.
  • We’re in the game together: Join a culture built on trust, support, and shared responsibility, where progress is achieved together and success is celebrated as a team.
  • Purpose‑driven environment: Be part of work that supports healthier, more active lives through our iconic sports and outdoor brands.
  • Small teams, real impact: Contribute in small, trusted teams within a global company, where your ideas matter and your work can create real impact.
  • Excellence in how we work: Join an environment where quality, innovation, and continuous improvement matter, and where people are encouraged to raise the bar in how work is done.
  • Ambitious career development: Develop your skills through meaningful work, new challenges, and collaboration with experienced colleagues.
  • Modern technologies and ways of working: Be part of teams that work with modern technologies and continuously evolve how we build, operate, and improve our digital solutions.
  • HR: As a member of our HR team, you’ll have the opportunity to engage in multiple global projects, experience continuous learning, and take pride in working with the world’s best sporting goods brands in our dynamic, ever-evolving environment.

Onsite, Pittston Township

We’re looking for an HR Business Partner for Amer Sports’ Distribution Center in Pittston Township, Pennsylvania.

Amer Sports is a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, powered by a community of people who share a passion for authenticity, impact, and excellence. We bring together leading brands, talented teams, and a culture built on collaboration. If you’re looking for an environment where you can make an impact and grow your career, we invite you to explore the opportunity below.

What you will be doing:

The HR Business Partner (HRBP) drives business results by aligning human resources strategies with operational goals in a high-volume, fast-paced distribution center. This role requires an exceptionally adaptable leader who utilizes data-driven insights and elite communication skills to resolve complex employee relations issues, build high-performing teams, and deliver impactful training.  To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily:To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily:

Employee Relations & Compliance

  • Serve as the primary expert on frontline and leadership employee relations issues.
  • Conduct objective, thorough investigations into high-risk complaints and policy violations.
  • De-escalate workplace conflicts using advanced interpersonal and mediation skills.
  • Maintain a highly visible, accessible, and trusted presence on the warehouse floor.
  • Ensure absolute compliance with local, state, and federal labor laws.
  • Partner closely with the Site Leader and facility safety representative to strengthen safety culture, ensure OSHA and company compliance, and support continuous improvement in workplace safety performance.

Training & Talent Development

  • Design, develop, and facilitate targeted training programs for frontline supervisors.
  • Coach warehouse managers on leadership capabilities, communication styles, and performance management.
  • Partner with site leadership on talent assessment, succession planning, and leadership development to build a strong pipeline of future leaders across the distribution center.
  • Lead culture initiatives to build morale and foster a collaborative, safe facility environment.
  • Optimize onboarding programs to drive immediate team integration and frontline retention.
  • Drive retention initiatives by identifying turnover trends, improving employee engagement, and partnering with operations leadership to enhance the overall employee experience.

Data Analytics & HR Technology

  • Utilize advanced Excel capabilities and HRIS platforms to audit and manage workforce data.
  • Manage employee records fluidly utilizing Workday and ADP systems.
  • Track operational metrics like turnover, absenteeism, and engagement trends.
  • Translate complex data into actionable talent insights for the operations leadership team.

Operational Flexibility & Strategic Partnership

  • Partner with logistics leadership to manage organizational change, peak seasonal surges, and warehouse growth.
  • Enforce company policies objectively while remaining agile to evolving business demands.
  • Support a 24/7 operation by occasionally adjusting hours to engage with night or weekend shifts.

What you need to succeed:

This role requires a Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of HR/generalist experience. The successful candidate is a resilient, proactive problem-solver who thrives in an autonomous environment while remaining deeply collaborative. You must be comfortable balancing strategic HR planning with the gritty, fast-moving realities of supply chain operations.  Other qualifications include:

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of HR experience within a high-volume distribution, logistics, or manufacturing setting.
  • Deep functional knowledge of FMLA, ADA, FLSA, and wage-and-hour regulations.

Required Core Competencies

  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills across diverse audiences, from frontline workers to executives.
  • Conflict Resolution: Proven mastery in investigation techniques, mediation, and risk mitigation.
  • Analytical Aptitude: Ability to manipulate large datasets, identify workforce trends, and present findings visually.
  • Adaptability: Proven resilience and emotional intelligence in a rapidly changing, fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual language skills (English/Spanish or relevant local demographic language).
  • Hands-on system administrator experience with Workday and ADP.
  • Professional HR certification (PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, or SHRM-SCP).
